string.name: search_try_other
string.value: Try another keyword or browse categories

string.name: game_snake_desc
string.value: Classic snake game, eat food to grow longer

string.name: game_tetris_desc
string.value: Classic Tetris, clear lines to score

string.name: game_whackmole_desc
string.value: Quick reflexes, tap the popping moles

string.name: game_sudoku_desc
string.value: Classic Sudoku, fill in the numbers

string.name: game_slidepuzzle_desc
string.value: Slide tiles to restore the picture

string.name: game_klotski_desc
string.value: Classic Klotski, slide blocks to free the target

string.name: game_memorycard_desc
string.value: Flip cards to find matching pairs

string.name: game_minesweeper_subtitle
string.value: Long press to flag · Tap to reveal

string.name: guess_hint_length_format
string.value: Guess a %1$d-digit code with unique digits

string.name: exit_confirm_desc
string.value: Your current game progress will be lost. Are you sure?

string.name: game_jumpjump_desc
string.value: Hold to charge, release to jump to the next platform

string.name: game_jumpjump_hint
string.value: Hold the screen to charge, release to jump

string.name: game_brickbreaker_desc
string.value: Move the paddle to bounce the ball and break bricks

string.name: game_brickbreaker_hint
string.value: Drag paddle or tap buttons to start

string.name: game_match3_desc
string.value: Swap adjacent gems to match and score

string.name: game_match3_hint
string.value: Tap a gem to select, then tap an adjacent gem to swap

string.name: home_empty_desc
string.value: The game list is currently empty

string.name: home_error_desc
string.value: Please try loading the games again

string.name: sudoku_generation_failed
string.value: Could not generate a puzzle. Please try again.

string.name: settings_intro
string.value: Make every game feel right for you.

string.name: settings_theme_desc
string.value: Applies immediately. System follows your device theme.

string.name: settings_theme_failed
string.value: Could not change the theme. Please try again.

string.name: settings_difficulty_desc
string.value: Applies when you next enter a game with difficulty options.

string.name: settings_remember_difficulty_desc
string.value: Use the last difficulty selected in each game; otherwise use the default.

string.name: settings_confirm_exit_desc
string.value: Protect progress from accidental exits. Turn off to leave immediately.

string.name: settings_reset_desc
string.value: Reset appearance and gameplay preferences. Keep all scores.

string.name: settings_reset_confirm
string.value: Restore the system theme, normal difficulty, vibration and exit confirmation. Disable difficulty memory and remove remembered difficulties. Scores are kept.

string.name: settings_clear_desc
string.value: Delete high scores, play counts and recent games.

string.name: settings_clear_confirm
string.value: Delete all high scores, play counts and recent games? This cannot be undone. Appearance and gameplay preferences will be kept.

string.name: settings_statement_content
string.value: Little Games is a collection of local casual games. Scores track your personal play. Games use different scoring rules, so scores do not represent a shared competitive ranking. Enjoy games in moderation.

string.name: settings_privacy_content
string.value: This version requires no account and does not upload play data. High scores, play counts, recent games and settings are stored on this device, with no in-app cloud sync. Clearing play data removes scores and history; restoring defaults only resets preferences. Uninstalling or clearing app data may remove local records.

string.name: settings_permission_content
string.value: Vibration is used for supported touch feedback and completion cues. You can turn it off in Settings. The app then stops requesting vibration. Devices without vibration can still play normally.

string.name: settings_help_content
string.value: Use the game header to change difficulty or restart. The default difficulty applies the next time you enter a game. With difficulty memory enabled, each game uses your last selection. Leaving does not save an unfinished board or level. Language and text size follow system settings.

string.name: immersive_light_content
string.value: The floating bottom tabs use native HarmonyOS immersive materials, follow the system color theme, and adapt to device capability and thermal conditions.

string.name: continuation_restore_failed
string.value: Unable to restore progress. Please reopen the game.

string.name: continuation_help_content
string.value: Use the system continuation entry on a nearby phone or tablet signed in to the same HUAWEI ID to continue your game or page. Both devices need a compatible app version and system continuation enabled. Snake, Tetris, Whack-a-Mole and Brick Breaker pause on arrival; tap resume when ready. Wait for Sudoku generation to finish before continuing.

string.name: collection_check_again
string.value: Some clues do not match yet. Keep adjusting.

string.name: game_tictactoe_rules
string.value: Take turns placing × and ○. Make a line of three horizontally, vertically or diagonally. A full board without a line is a draw.

string.name: game_gomoku_desc
string.value: Make five in a row on a 9×9 board.

string.name: game_gomoku_rules
string.value: Two local players take turns. Five or more consecutive pieces wins in any direction. Free placement rules; no forbidden moves.

string.name: game_reversi_desc
string.value: Bracket opposing discs to capture them.

string.name: game_reversi_rules
string.value: Play locally with two players. Place a disc to bracket opponents along a straight line and flip them. A player with no move passes automatically. When neither can move, most discs wins. Dots mark legal moves.

string.name: game_fourline_rules
string.value: Two local players tap a column in turn. Pieces fall to the lowest empty slot. Connect four in any direction to win.

string.name: game_nim_desc
string.value: Take one to three; the last stone wins.

string.name: game_nim_rules
string.value: Two local players remove 1–3 stones per turn, up to the remaining count. Taking the last stone wins. Difficulty changes the starting pile.

string.name: game_lights_desc
string.value: Toggle a cross to turn all lights off.

string.name: game_lights_rules
string.value: Tap a cell to toggle it and its four immediate neighbors. Turn off every warm yellow light. Every puzzle is generated from a solved board.

string.name: game_flood_desc
string.value: Unify the board from the top-left region.

string.name: game_flood_rules
string.value: Choose a numbered color to recolor the connected top-left region and absorb matching neighbors. Unify the board within the move limit. Numbers identify colors too.

string.name: game_maze_desc
string.value: Find a path through a generated maze.

string.name: game_maze_rules
string.value: The robot is you, the green arch is the exit, and hedges are walls. Tap an adjacent open cell or use the direction buttons. Reach the exit. Every generated maze is connected.

string.name: game_hanoi_desc
string.value: Move a tower between three posts.

string.name: game_hanoi_rules
string.value: Select a source post, then a destination. Only the top disc can move; larger discs cannot sit on smaller ones. Move every disc to post 3. Smaller numbers mean smaller discs.

string.name: game_peg_desc
string.value: Jump over pegs until only one remains.

string.name: game_peg_rules
string.value: Select a peg, then an empty hole two cells away in a straight line. Jump over and remove the middle peg. Leave one peg to win. No legal jumps ends the game. Boards are generated with reverse legal moves.

string.name: game_nonogram_desc
string.value: Fill a grid using row and column runs.

string.name: game_nonogram_rules
string.value: Clues give lengths of filled runs. For example, 2 1 means two filled cells, at least one gap, then one filled cell. Tap to toggle and check when ready. Any grid matching all clues is accepted.

string.name: game_arithmetic_desc
string.value: Ten questions of addition, subtraction and multiplication.

string.name: game_arithmetic_rules
string.value: Choose the correct answer to each of ten questions. Correct answers earn points based on difficulty; wrong answers earn none.

string.name: game_compare_desc
string.value: Compare the values of two expressions.

string.name: game_compare_rules
string.value: Compare the two expressions and choose <, = or >. Answer ten questions; correct answers earn points.

string.name: game_sequence_desc
string.value: Find the pattern and complete the sequence.

string.name: game_sequence_rules
string.value: Choose the next term. Sequences use a constant difference; hard mode may also use doubling. Ten questions, scored for correct answers.

string.name: game_binary_rules
string.value: Convert the base-2 number to base 10 and select an answer. Ten questions. Higher difficulty increases the number range.

string.name: game_targetsum_desc
string.value: Find the missing number in an addition.

string.name: game_targetsum_rules
string.value: Given a sum and two addends, choose the missing addend. Ten questions; correct answers score points.

string.name: game_schulte_desc
string.value: Find all numbers in ascending order.

string.name: game_schulte_rules
string.value: Tap numbers in order from 1 to the last. Wrong taps count as moves but do not advance the target. Fewer taps earns a better score.

string.name: game_memorysequence_desc
string.value: Memorize and reproduce a digit sequence.

string.name: game_memorysequence_rules
string.value: Study the sequence, then tap Ready to hide it. Tap the digits in the same order, including repetitions. One incorrect tap ends the round.

string.name: game_missing_desc
string.value: Remember a set and find the missing number.

string.name: game_missing_rules
string.value: Memorize the displayed set, then tap Ready. One number disappears. Choose the missing number from memory. Ten questions; correct answers earn points.

string.name: game_reaction_desc
string.value: Wait for the signal and test your response.

string.name: game_reaction_rules
string.value: Tap to start and wait for the Tap now signal. Tapping early fails. Your response time is shown in milliseconds; score is 2000 minus that time, minimum zero. Backgrounding or opening exit confirmation resets the timing trial.

string.name: collection_art_tower
string.value: Post %d, discs from top to bottom: %s

string.name: game_blockfit_desc
string.value: Select a piece, then tap its top-left position on the board

string.name: game_blockfit_rules
string.value: Select a piece, then tap its top-left position on the board. Full rows and columns clear together. Use all three pieces to refill. Reach the target score to win; no legal placement ends the game.

string.name: game_tilestack_desc
string.value: Tap the top tile of a stack to put it in the seven-slot tray

string.name: game_tilestack_rules
string.value: Tap the top tile of a stack to put it in the seven-slot tray. Three identical tiles clear. Clear every stack to win; filling the tray loses. The badge shows the remaining stack depth.

string.name: game_bubbleshooter_desc
string.value: Tap the arena to aim and fire

string.name: game_bubbleshooter_rules
string.value: Tap the arena to aim and fire. Shots bounce off side walls. Connect at least three bubbles of one color to clear them; detached bubbles fall too. Clear the board to win. Reaching the bottom line or running out of shots loses.

string.name: game_fruitmerge_desc
string.value: Tap the top of the container to drop a fruit

string.name: game_fruitmerge_rules
string.value: Tap the top of the container to drop a fruit. Touching fruits of the same tier merge into a larger one. Make the highest tier to win; fruit remaining above the warning line loses.

string.name: game_watersort_desc
string.value: Tap a source tube, then a destination to pour one top layer into an empty tube or onto the same color

string.name: game_watersort_rules
string.value: Tap a source tube, then a destination to pour one top layer into an empty tube or onto the same color. Each tube holds four layers. Fill each nonempty tube with a single color to win. Undo is available.

string.name: game_arrowclear_desc
string.value: Tap an arrow to send it out of the board

string.name: game_arrowclear_rules
string.value: Tap an arrow to send it out of the board. Another arrow in its path blocks it. Clear the board to win. Three blocked attempts lose.

string.name: game_screwout_desc
string.value: Tap an uncovered screw to move it into one of three temporary holes

string.name: game_screwout_rules
string.value: Tap an uncovered screw to move it into one of three temporary holes. Removing all three screws of a plate clears that plate and its parked screws, freeing the holes. Remove every plate to win.

string.name: game_parkingjam_desc
string.value: Tap a car to drive it out in its arrow direction

string.name: game_parkingjam_rules
string.value: Tap a car to drive it out in its arrow direction. Cars ahead block the exit. Plan the exit order and clear the parking lot to win.

string.name: game_runner_desc
string.value: Switch between three lanes with the left and right buttons

string.name: game_runner_rules
string.value: Switch between three lanes with the left and right buttons. Avoid roadblocks and collect coins as speed increases. Reach the target score to win; hitting a roadblock ends the run.

string.name: game_blackhole_desc
string.value: Tap or drag to guide a growing hole

string.name: game_blackhole_rules
string.value: Tap or drag to guide a growing hole. Swallow smaller objects to grow enough for larger ones. Clear every object before time runs out to win.

string.name: game_fisheat_desc
string.value: Tap or drag to guide your fish

string.name: game_fisheat_rules
string.value: Tap or drag to guide your fish. Eat smaller fish to grow. A substantially larger fish ends the game. Eat the target number to win.

string.name: game_sokoban_desc
string.value: Move with the direction buttons and push every box onto a marked goal

string.name: game_sokoban_rules
string.value: Move with the direction buttons and push every box onto a marked goal. Push one box at a time; boxes cannot be pulled. Undo or restart if stuck.

string.name: game_pipes_desc
string.value: Tap a pipe to rotate it clockwise

string.name: game_pipes_rules
string.value: Tap a pipe to rotate it clockwise. Connect the blue source to the outlet through every pipe with no open leaks. Blue marks the connected flow.

string.name: game_differences_desc
string.value: Compare the two scenes and tap changed objects in the right scene

string.name: game_differences_rules
string.value: Compare the two scenes and tap changed objects in the right scene. Find every difference to win. Three incorrect taps end the game. Found differences receive a border.

string.name: game_roomdefense_desc
string.value: Build towers in six slots to defend the room

string.name: game_roomdefense_rules
string.value: Build towers in six slots to defend the room. Earn coins every second, upgrade towers and repair the door. Defeat every enemy while keeping the room intact to win.

string.name: game_basketball_desc
string.value: Tap near the hoop to aim a high arc

string.name: game_basketball_rules
string.value: Tap near the hoop to aim a high arc. The ball must pass down through the hoop to score. The hoop moves on normal and hard modes. Make the target number of baskets within sixteen shots.

string.name: game_solitaire_desc
string.value: Draw one card from the stock

string.name: game_solitaire_rules
string.value: Draw one card from the stock. Select a face-up card and tap a destination column. Build columns in alternating colors and descending ranks; only kings fill empty columns. Use Foundation to build each suit from ace to king. Collect all cards to win.

string.name: game_characters_desc
string.value: Study the target Chinese character and choose its components

string.name: game_characters_rules
string.value: Study the target Chinese character and choose its components. A component can be chosen more than once. Check the combination to advance. Complete eight characters to win; three mistakes end the game.

string.name: game_rhythm_desc
string.value: Start the sequence and tap the matching lane key as a note reaches the line

string.name: game_rhythm_rules
string.value: Start the sequence and tap the matching lane key as a note reaches the line. Closer timing earns more points. Complete the sequence to win; five missed or incorrect taps end the game.

string.name: game_restaurant_desc
string.value: Spend two coins to cook a dish and wait for it to enter the serving stock

string.name: game_restaurant_rules
string.value: Spend two coins to cook a dish and wait for it to enter the serving stock. Tap a customer to serve the requested dish and earn ten coins. Complete the target orders within two minutes. Losing five customers ends the game.

string.name: game_linktiles_rules
string.value: Tap two matching tiles. Their connecting path may turn at most twice and must avoid other tiles. Paths can go around the board border. Clear every tile to win. Rearrange provides a playable pair and a hint.

string.name: game_mahjongsolitaire_desc
string.value: Pair two matching free tiles: no tile covers either one, and at least one horizontal side is open

string.name: game_mahjongsolitaire_rules
string.value: Pair two matching free tiles: no tile covers either one, and at least one horizontal side is open. Clear all layers to win. Dimmed tiles are blocked. Rearrange the remaining tiles or undo if stuck.

string.name: game_groupclear_desc
string.value: Tap a group of at least two orthogonally adjacent blocks of one color

string.name: game_groupclear_rules
string.value: Tap a group of at least two orthogonally adjacent blocks of one color. Larger groups earn squared bonuses. Blocks fall down and empty columns slide left. Clear the board or meet the target when no groups remain to win.

string.name: game_slotpair_desc
string.value: Tap a column to drop the next block

string.name: game_slotpair_rules
string.value: Tap a column to drop the next block. Adjacent groups of at least two matching blocks clear and cascade. Finish the sequence with an empty board to win. A full board or leftover blocks at the end loses.

string.name: game_buscolor_desc
string.value: Passengers board matching buses in queue order

string.name: game_buscolor_rules
string.value: Passengers board matching buses in queue order. A bus leaves when its three seats fill. Tap the front bus of a lane to send it to one of three waiting slots. Board everyone to win. Undo to change the dispatch order if slots are blocked.

string.name: game_yarn_desc
string.value: Choose a reel, then tap a yarn column to wind its exposed run of one color

string.name: game_yarn_rules
string.value: Choose a reel, then tap a yarn column to wind its exposed run of one color. Empty reels accept any color; partially filled reels accept only their color. Eight units complete a reel. Wind all yarn to win.

string.name: game_sand_desc
string.value: Select a colored nozzle and tap matching sand

string.name: game_sand_rules
string.value: Select a colored nozzle and tap matching sand. Collect connected grains, up to the remaining space in an eight-grain can. Sand falls down afterward. Fill two cans per color and clear the picture to win.

string.name: game_untangle_desc
string.value: Drag the numbered nodes until ropes with separate endpoints no longer cross, touch or overlap

string.name: game_untangle_rules
string.value: Drag the numbered nodes until ropes with separate endpoints no longer cross, touch or overlap. Orange ropes still have intersections. Reduce the intersection count to zero to win. Undo reverses a complete drag.

string.name: game_platformer_desc
string.value: Hold left or right to move and tap Jump to cross platform gaps

string.name: game_platformer_rules
string.value: Hold left or right to move and tap Jump to cross platform gaps. Land before jumping again. Reach the flag to win; falling below the course loses.

string.name: game_grapple_desc
string.value: Hook onto the next anchor and swing under gravity

string.name: game_grapple_rules
string.value: Hook onto the next anchor and swing under gravity. Release to launch forward, then connect to another anchor. Platforms provide landing spots. Reach the flag to win; falling loses.

string.name: game_flappy_desc
string.value: Start and tap Flap to rise against gravity

string.name: game_flappy_rules
string.value: Start and tap Flap to rise against gravity. Fly through the gaps in the moving gates. Pass the target number to win; hitting a gate or the arena boundary loses.

string.name: game_fruitslice_desc
string.value: Start and swipe through flying fruit

string.name: game_fruitslice_rules
string.value: Start and swipe through flying fruit. A swipe can slice several fruit, earning fifty points each. Slicing a bomb, missing five fruit or missing the target within sixty seconds loses.

string.name: game_rollingball_desc
string.value: Tap or drag a destination to guide the ball with momentum

string.name: game_rollingball_rules
string.value: Tap or drag a destination to guide the ball with momentum. It bounces off walls. Avoid the black holes and roll to the green flag to win.

string.name: game_shooter_desc
string.value: Start and drag your plane to avoid enemies while firing upward automatically

string.name: game_shooter_rules
string.value: Start and drag your plane to avoid enemies while firing upward automatically. Clear every wave to win. Enemy contact or an enemy crossing the defense line costs a life; losing three lives ends the run.

string.name: game_tanks_desc
string.value: Drag your tank while its turret targets the nearest enemy

string.name: game_tanks_rules
string.value: Drag your tank while its turret targets the nearest enemy. Avoid pursuing tanks and their shells. Defeat every attacker to win; losing three health points ends the battle.

string.name: game_fortress_desc
string.value: Tap near an enemy to fire a shell with splash damage

string.name: game_fortress_rules
string.value: Tap near an enemy to fire a shell with splash damage. Defeated enemies award coins; spend twenty to upgrade firepower. Defeat the army to win. The castle falling to zero health loses.

string.name: game_survival_desc
string.value: Drag to escape pursuers while your weapon targets the nearest enemy

string.name: game_survival_rules
string.value: Drag to escape pursuers while your weapon targets the nearest enemy. Defeat every wave to win. Contact costs a health point; losing all health ends the run.

string.name: game_backpack_desc
string.value: Choose a sword, shield, potion or boots and place it in the four-by-four backpack

string.name: game_backpack_rules
string.value: Choose a sword, shield, potion or boots and place it in the four-by-four backpack. Items have different sizes and costs. Fight five rounds: swords add attack, shields reduce damage, potions heal and boots add speed. Zero health loses. Undo is available.

string.name: game_billiards_desc
string.value: Tap a direction to strike the cue ball

string.name: game_billiards_rules
string.value: Tap a direction to strike the cue ball. Balls transfer momentum in collisions and bounce off cushions. Pocket all five colored balls to win. Four cue-ball scratches lose. Wait for all balls to stop before another shot.

string.name: game_penalty_desc
string.value: Start, watch the moving keeper and tap a target inside the goal to shoot

string.name: game_penalty_rules
string.value: Start, watch the moving keeper and tap a target inside the goal to shoot. Cross the line clear of the keeper to score. Make five goals within eight attempts to win.

string.name: game_pingpong_desc
string.value: Start and drag the lower paddle to return the ball

string.name: game_pingpong_rules
string.value: Start and drag the lower paddle to return the ball. Passing the opponent baseline scores; passing your baseline gives the opponent a point. First to seven wins. Off-center hits change the return angle.

string.name: game_bowling_desc
string.value: Tap toward the pins to bowl

string.name: game_bowling_rules
string.value: Tap toward the pins to bowl. Hits can knock down neighboring pins. The ball resets after leaving the lane. Knock down the target within three rolls; hard mode requires all ten pins.

string.name: game_golf_desc
string.value: Tap a direction to putt; farther targets produce stronger shots

string.name: game_golf_rules
string.value: Tap a direction to putt; farther targets produce stronger shots. The ball slows and bounces off walls. Navigate the barriers and enter the green cup at low speed. You have twenty strokes.

string.name: game_drift_desc
string.value: Start and tap Drift to reverse the car's sideways motion

string.name: game_drift_rules
string.value: Start and tap Drift to reverse the car's sideways motion. Keep it inside the curving road until the timer finishes. Leaving the road loses.

string.name: game_hillclimb_desc
string.value: Hold the accelerator or brake to control speed over rolling hills

string.name: game_hillclimb_rules
string.value: Hold the accelerator or brake to control speed over rolling hills. Reach the target distance to win. Running out of fuel or a hard landing loses. Releasing a button stops accelerating.

string.name: game_airhockey_desc
string.value: Start and drag your mallet in the lower half to strike the puck

string.name: game_airhockey_rules
string.value: Start and drag your mallet in the lower half to strike the puck. Send it through the opponent's central goal to score. Your goal concedes a point. First to five wins; side walls rebound the puck.

string.name: game_tug_desc
string.value: Two players tap their own buttons to pull the marker

string.name: game_tug_rules
string.value: Two players tap their own buttons to pull the marker. Blue wins at one hundred; red wins at zero. Play together on one device.

string.name: game_dots_desc
string.value: Take turns drawing edges between neighboring dots

string.name: game_dots_rules
string.value: Take turns drawing edges between neighboring dots. Completing a box claims it and grants another turn. When every box is claimed, the player with more boxes wins.

string.name: game_doudizhu_desc
string.value: A single offline round with you as landlord against two computer farmers

string.name: game_doudizhu_rules
string.value: A single offline round with you as landlord against two computer farmers. Play singles, pairs, triples with attachments, straights, pair runs, airplanes, four-with-two, bombs and the joker rocket. Select cards and play a stronger matching pattern, or use a bomb. Empty your hand first to win.

string.name: game_guandan_desc
string.value: A single offline four-player partnership round

string.name: game_guandan_rules
string.value: A single offline four-player partnership round. You partner with player three; twos are fixed level cards, with no tribute or multi-round leveling. Heart twos are wild. Play singles, pairs, triples, full houses, five-card straights, three-pair runs, two-triple runs, bombs, straight flushes and four jokers. Partners inherit a finished teammate's lead. The first finisher's team wins.

string.name: game_mahjong_desc
string.value: Offline four-player mahjong with 136 tiles and no flowers or scoring multipliers

string.name: game_mahjong_rules
string.value: Offline four-player mahjong with 136 tiles and no flowers or scoring multipliers. Tap a tile twice to discard. Chow the previous player, pong, or declare open and closed kongs with replacement draws. Four melds and a pair, or seven pairs, wins. An exhausted wall draws the game.

string.name: game_xiangqi_rules
string.value: Play red against the computer. Select a piece and a highlighted legal destination. Horse legs, elephant eyes, cannon screens, river crossing and palace limits are enforced. Your general must remain safe and may not face the other general. Checkmate or stalemate wins; three repetitions draw.

string.name: game_chess_rules
string.value: Play white against the computer. Select a piece and a highlighted move. Castling, en passant and promotion are supported; choose queen, rook, bishop or knight before promotion. Your king must remain safe. Checkmate wins. Stalemate, three repetitions, fifty moves without a pawn move or capture, or basic insufficient material draw automatically.

string.name: game_ludo_desc
string.value: Race four blue planes against three computer players

string.name: game_ludo_rules
string.value: Race four blue planes against three computer players. Roll six to launch and play again. Matching outer squares jump four steps; landing on an opponent sends it home. Overshooting the finish bounces back. Finish all four planes first to win.

string.name: game_spider_rules
string.value: One-suit spider with 104 cards. Select a descending face-up sequence and a destination one rank higher, or an empty column. Complete king-to-ace sequences clear automatically. Collect eight runs to win. Deal one card to every column only when no column is empty.

string.name: game_freecell_desc
string.value: Move 52 cards between eight columns in alternating colors and descending ranks

string.name: game_freecell_rules
string.value: Move 52 cards between eight columns in alternating colors and descending ranks. Four free cells hold single cards. Empty cells and columns determine the maximum movable sequence. Build four foundations by suit from ace to king to win.

string.name: game_onestroke_desc
string.value: Choose a starting node and follow connected nodes in one continuous trail

string.name: game_onestroke_rules
string.value: Choose a starting node and follow connected nodes in one continuous trail. Traverse every edge exactly once; revisiting a node is allowed. Complete all edges to win. Undo if you reach a dead end.

string.name: game_hiddenobjects_desc
string.value: Study the target objects and find one of each in the scene

string.name: game_hiddenobjects_rules
string.value: Study the target objects and find one of each in the scene. Any instance of the matching symbol counts. Find six types to win. Three incorrect taps lose; repeated finds do not score.

string.name: game_linerescue_desc
string.value: Draw a fixed barrier by dragging, then start

string.name: game_linerescue_rules
string.value: Draw a fixed barrier by dragging, then start. The line blocks bees pursuing the dog; the total drawing length is limited to 650 units. Protect the dog for ten seconds to win. Bee contact loses. Clear and redraw before starting.

string.name: game_picturepuzzle_desc
string.value: Use the complete image as a reference

string.name: game_picturepuzzle_rules
string.value: Use the complete image as a reference. Tap two fragments to swap them; any pair may be exchanged. Restore the scene to win. Higher difficulties use more fragments, and fewer swaps earn more points.

string.name: game_idiom_desc
string.value: Complete the missing character in a four-character Chinese idiom from four choices

string.name: game_idiom_rules
string.value: Complete the missing character in a four-character Chinese idiom from four choices. Answer eight questions to win. Three mistakes end the game. Normal and hard modes vary the blank position.

string.name: game_wordtower_desc
string.value: Choose wood, fire, water or metal and spend six coins to build in an empty slot

string.name: game_wordtower_rules
string.value: Choose wood, fire, water or metal and spend six coins to build in an empty slot. Select three matching basic character towers to merge them into a stronger triple-character tower. Start defending; towers fire automatically and coins accrue over time. Clear every wave to win; zero defense health loses.

string.name: game_beatjump_desc
string.value: Watch the upcoming left, center or right cue and tap its button as the countdown reaches zero

string.name: game_beatjump_rules
string.value: Watch the upcoming left, center or right cue and tap its button as the countdown reaches zero. The ball jumps to that platform. Complete every beat to win. Five wrong, early, late or missed taps lose.

string.name: game_melody_desc
string.value: Play, listen to and observe the four pitches, then tap the keys in the same order

string.name: game_melody_rules
string.value: Play, listen to and observe the four pitches, then tap the keys in the same order. Each successful round adds one note. Complete five rounds to win. Replay the current melody when needed; three mistakes end the game.

string.name: game_farm_desc
string.value: Choose a planting, watering or harvesting tool, then tap a plot

string.name: game_farm_rules
string.value: Choose a planting, watering or harvesting tool, then tap a plot. Seeds cost two coins. Watered plants mature the next day; unwatered seeds wither. A harvest earns five coins. Complete twelve harvests to win.

string.name: game_decorate_desc
string.value: Decorate a five-by-five room with a sofa, table, plants and lamp, each with a different footprint and price

string.name: game_decorate_rules
string.value: Decorate a five-by-five room with a sofa, table, plants and lamp, each with a different footprint and price. With twenty coins, place a sofa, two plants, a lamp and a table beside the sofa to win. Sell removes furniture and refunds its cost.

string.name: game_fishing_desc
string.value: Cast and wait for the bite cue, then set the hook promptly

string.name: game_fishing_rules
string.value: Cast and wait for the bite cue, then set the hook promptly. Hold to reel, increasing progress and tension; release to ease the line. Tension below five or above ninety-five loses the fish. Catch five to win; three missed hooks or broken lines end the trip.
